source_title: LG Refrigerator - How to Install Your Refrigerator Water Filter
filter_location_text: LG support guidance says the filter housing is in the back-left area of the refrigerator interior. Remove obstacles such as the top-left shelf when needed so the housing can move fully.
replacement_steps_summary: LG support guidance describes opening the filter housing, pulling the filter down to remove it, then inserting and seating the replacement filter before closing the housing.
cautions: LG support guidance notes a small amount of water can drain during replacement and recommends flushing about 2.5 gallons after installation. LG control guidance says to hold the Water Filter button for 3 seconds to reset the indicator.
notes: Tier 1 bundle based on official LG support/help resources. ManualsLib retained as lower-tier reference only.
